risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Public ticketing is exposed during predictable demand peaks.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Customers may lose ticket access and support/revenue may be affected. Prepared fallback is possible.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Digital tickets are targeted for copying, sharing and resale abuse. Offline or rushed checks are susceptible.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Gate crowding, revenue loss and disputes.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Payment systems are attractive targets but are more restricted than typical office computers.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Payment exposure, interrupted sales and contractual or compliance consequences.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Multiple device types, temporary connections and vendors make configuration errors realistic.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Guest access can reach critical operational services.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Many cameras and remote administration points broaden the exposure.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Footage can be exposed and security monitoring impaired during an event.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Legacy components and vendor access create exposure within the controlled network.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Manipulated ventilation or lighting can create serious safety and operations consequences.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Devices from different vendors may have weak authentication or firmware.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Wrong crowd or facility data can cause poor operational decisions.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Signage controllers may be remotely managed and use shared accounts.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: False or offensive content can disrupt the event and damage reputation.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Frequent changes and human configuration errors are realistic.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Exposed permissions or storage can leak data and disrupt digital services.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Administrators are targeted by phishing, stolen credentials and token theft.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: One privileged account can reach multiple systems and disable controls.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Many endpoints, email accounts and remote connections create multiple entry paths.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: A single event can affect ticketing, office IT, stadium operations and recovery.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Valuable records connect to public ticketing and mobile services.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Personal-data disclosure can lead to legal, financial and reputational harm.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: PASS relies on vendors whose security it cannot fully control.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Trusted vendor access or update channels can reach important systems.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Attackers with administrative access often target backups.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Recovering core services takes longer and can affect future events.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Multiple vendors and systems increase logging gaps and misconfiguration.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Attacks continue longer before detection, increasing harm.

risk_rationales.likelihood_basis: Limited monitoring makes spoofed input and undetected drift realistic.
risk_rationales.impact_basis: Wrong estimates can lead to under- or over-reaction to crowd conditions.
